idea-plugin.name: Kei - API Contract Testing
idea-plugin.description:
Kei — API Contract Testing

Stop shipping breaking API changes. Kei validates your code against OpenAPI and GraphQL contracts in real time, catching mismatches between your implementation and your API specification before they cause production incidents.

Key Features

  • Real-Time Validation — Inline warnings when code diverges from your API contract
  • OpenAPI & GraphQL — Supports OpenAPI 3.x specifications and GraphQL schemas
  • Breaking Change Detection — Highlights backward-incompatible changes with severity levels
  • Multi-Language Support — Works with TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, and Kotlin
  • Contract Diff Viewer — Side-by-side comparison of contract versions
  • Smart Quick Fixes — Auto-generate code stubs and fix type mismatches

Why Kei?

API contract violations are one of the top causes of integration failures. Kei shifts contract testing left — validating contracts at development time instead of in staging or production.

Free vs Pro

  • Free: Basic OpenAPI validation, inline warnings, contract discovery
  • Pro: GraphQL support, breaking change analysis, contract diff viewer, team contract registry, CI/CD hooks, and mock server generation
